meta.name: game-world-design
meta.description: Design game experience, systems, and levels. Converge the chosen concept into one GAME_DESIGN defining the player promise, core loop, how the world responds, the systems actually needed, level pacing, feedback, failure, and a fully playable prototype. Use for design the game world, deepen the gameplay and levels, write the game design document. 游戏体验、系统与关卡策划。把选定概念收束为一份 GAME_DESIGN，定义玩家承诺、核心循环、世界响应、必要系统、关卡节奏、反馈、失败和可完整游玩的原型。用于设计游戏世界、深化玩法和关卡等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把游戏概念收束为可玩原型的设计方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在构思游戏世界、核心循环与关卡体验
copy.tagline_en: Turn a game concept into a playable prototype design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're defining game worlds, core loops, and level experiences

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会依素材产出《GAME_DESIGN.md》，写明玩家承诺、核心循环、世界规则、关卡节奏、反馈失败，并附数值预算与 go/no-go 表。
howto.when: 当你给出《SOURCE_BIBLE.md》《CONCEPT.md》《PRODUCT_BRIEF.md》并让 Claude 设计游戏世界、深化玩法或关卡、撰写 GDD 时接管。

say.text: 基于这三份文档，把概念收束成一份 GAME_DESIGN。
say.note: 会生成完整 GDD，含玩家承诺与核心循环。

say.text: 按教会→变式→组合→检验→命运回收设计最小验证切片。
say.note: 产出每拍的玩家已知、新压力与反馈。

say.text: 为这个玩法写数值预算表，并演算及格线路径。
say.note: 给出起始值、典型增减幅与最少动作数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will produce design/GAME_DESIGN.md from the supplied source files, defining player promise, core loop, world rules, level pacing, feedback and failure, plus numeric budgets, a category go/no-go table and playtest questions.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to design a game world, deepen gameplay/levels, or write a GDD, and provide SOURCE_BIBLE.md, CONCEPT.md, and PRODUCT_BRIEF.md.

say_en.text: Based on these docs, converge the concept into a GAME_DESIGN.
say_en.note: Produces a full GDD with player promise and core loop.

say_en.text: Design a minimal playable slice using teach→vary→combine→test→fate.
say_en.note: Each beat lists known info, new pressure, and observable feedback.

say_en.text: Build a numeric budget table for this mechanic and trace a pass line.
say_en.note: Gives starting values, typical deltas, and minimum actions per tier.
